high.blurb: You're drawn to novel ideas, art, and abstract thinking over routine and convention.
high.strength: You bring fresh, unconventional angles to problems everyone else sees the same way.
high.growth: Can chase the next interesting idea before finishing the current one.

low.blurb: You favor the practical and proven over the abstract and untested.
low.strength: You stay grounded in what's concrete and demonstrably reliable.
low.growth: May dismiss an unconventional idea before really considering it.

high.blurb: You plan ahead, follow through, and hold yourself to a high standard.
high.strength: People can count on you to deliver on what you said you would.
high.growth: Standards can tip into perfectionism that slows things down.

low.blurb: You prefer to stay flexible and adapt in the moment rather than plan in detail.
low.strength: You adapt quickly when plans change and rarely feel boxed in.
low.growth: Deadlines and routine follow-through can slip without more structure.

high.blurb: You draw energy from people and tend to think out loud in a group.
high.strength: You build momentum and warmth in a room quickly.
high.growth: May need to consciously build in quieter, low-stimulation time.

low.blurb: You recharge in quieter settings and prefer depth over breadth in conversation.
low.strength: You bring calm, focused attention to one-on-one conversations.
low.growth: Can be overlooked in loud group settings unless you push to be heard.

high.blurb: You prioritize harmony and genuinely enjoy helping the people around you.
high.strength: You build trust and cooperation with people quickly and sincerely.
high.growth: Can avoid necessary conflict to keep the peace.

low.blurb: You're comfortable prioritizing your own judgment over group consensus.
low.strength: You'll say the hard, honest thing that keeps a group from fooling itself.
low.growth: Directness can land as blunt when warmth would land better.

high.blurb: You feel emotions intensely and stay alert to what could go wrong.
high.strength: Your vigilance catches risks that more relaxed people miss entirely.
high.growth: Worry can spend energy on things that never end up happening.

low.blurb: You tend to stay calm and emotionally steady, even under real pressure.
low.strength: You stay level-headed in moments that would rattle most people.
low.growth: Low urgency can mean real risks get underestimated.
